CDH1 and your next conversation

Understand the result, keep uncertainty in perspective, and prepare questions for a genetics professional.

Questions for my team

Editorial preparation · September 28, 2026

Educational summary prepared with AI assistance from the linked sources. Genetics content reviewed and approved by Alex Ehsan, MD, PhD on September 28, 2026.

What CDH1 means

CDH1 helps make E-cadherin, a protein that helps cells stay connected. Everyone has this gene. The exact genetic change and its classification determine what a result may mean.

What changes the discussion

Certain inherited pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants are associated with diffuse stomach cancer and lobular breast cancer. A finding in tumor tissue does not by itself establish an inherited condition. A variant of uncertain significance, or VUS, is not a confirmed harmful result and should not alone determine preventive surgery.

The next conversation

For a confirmed inherited harmful variant, a specialist team can discuss expert stomach surveillance, risk-reducing surgery, breast screening when relevant, and nutrition. The balance depends on the variant, age, family history and individual circumstances. This guide cannot calculate personal risk or choose a screening schedule.

Prepare for your genetics appointment

Bring the laboratory report and a family history with cancer types and ages at diagnosis to your clinician. Select the questions you want to discuss.

A conversation with family

You can ask your genetics team for a family letter that explains the confirmed finding and where relatives can seek counseling. Share only information you choose to share.

When not to wait

Vomiting blood, black stools with weakness or fainting, or another possible emergency needs urgent medical attention. Do not wait for genetic counseling or a website reply.
